title: Pipelines unwrap single-item results to scalars — force @() for collection semantics
symptoms: .Count or indexing fails or misbehaves when a query returned exactly one item
$null where an empty array was expected
explanation: A pipeline or cmdlet returning zero or one items yields a scalar in some contexts and $null/empty in others. When output is used later as a collection, wrap in @() to force array semantics.
